# County Lines 

```{python}
proc_dir = data_dir / "_Processed"
county_path = data_dir / "vermont" / "countyLines.geojson"
con.execute(
    f"CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW counties AS SELECT *  FROM ST_Read('{county_path}')"
)

desc = con.execute("DESCRIBE counties").df()
```


```{python}
df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM counties").df()
df
```

We want the CNTYGEOID, the CNTYNAME, and the geometry...

```{python}
con.execute(f"""--sql
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW counties_clean AS
    SELECT
        CNTYGEOID AS CountyFIPS,
        CNTYNAME AS CountyName,
        geom
    FROM ST_Read('{county_path}')
""")
df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM counties_clean").df()
df.head()
```

Matches against wikipedia, so we're good.
